searchText: Do you have a plan how to proceed with subroutines + initcode cap? I'm honestly happily occupied with some other work... No, but publishing the initcode cap EIP is a good first step I suppose -- regardless of subroutines I wanted to push one change to subroutines: to rename `BEGINSUB` to `SUBROUTINE` (I think <@!211091239112671234> suggested that in some comment). I'm all for it, but I don't want to push 'random' changes without approval from at least Greg and/or other client devs Perhaps post a question in the acd gitter? <@!425274498732916736> I think `BEGINSUB` is motivated by programming languages which use the terminology of beginsub, returnsub, etc. But your motivation is that the opcode is not doing "anything" and "begin" can be misleading? Yes, "begin" verb suggests there is some work to do... `SUBDEST`? I don't mind what name is used for it though Now that we've changed the opcodes -- I have a dump of deduped code, (code, codehash) that is `2.2G`. Anyone want it (for analysis)?
